--- PART 1/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "The general advice emphasizes cooperation. So maybe safest is to cooperate mostly and only defect last round."
STRATEGY: Parent is basic TFT with cooperation first 3, retaliate last opp D, defect if opp defects >=3 and ratio >=1/3, forgive if my_defects > opp_defects + 2. Simulated against population slots and archive, focusing on IPD payoffs and endgame exploitation. Changed by designing a forgiving TFT with opponent modeling, chronic-defector detection, and endgame defection.

--- PART 2/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice emphasizes cooperation, suggesting archive is cooperative." and "Given the population is mostly TFT-like with some forgiveness, maybe the best is to avoid defecting at all."
STRATEGY: The parent is a TFT-like strategy that cooperates by default, retaliates when the opponent defects, and cooperates again if the opponent cooperates. The trace simulates the parent against TFT, always-D, always-C, Pavlov, and slot8/slot3-style opponents, focusing on alternating retaliation cycles and endgame defection. It proposes revisions such as forgiving after mutual defection, probing for always-C opponents, and defecting only on the last round against retaliatory opponents.

--- PART 3/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice says 'begin cooperatively', 'preserve mutual cooperation'. It doesn't mention exploiting always C." and "Given the general advice emphasizes cooperation, probably archive is cooperative."
STRATEGY: Parent is a cooperative TFT-like strategy with chronic-defector detection and endgame defection. The trace simulates TFT, always C, always D, and occasional exploiters, then revises forgiveness, chronic-defector thresholds, probing, and endgame exploitation rules.

--- PART 4/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Given the general advice emphasizes cooperation, probably archive is cooperative." / "The general advice emphasizes cooperation, so archive is probably not always C."
STRATEGY: Parent is a deterministic TFT-like strategy with first-three-round cooperation, retaliation on last opponent defection, and a chronic-defector threshold. The trace simulates candidate revisions against population members (TFT, always C, always D, slot2, slot3, slot8, parent slot7) and considers probes/endgame defection. It changes the strategy to a forgiving TFT with last-round defection and chronic-defector detection, rejecting mid-game probing.

--- PART 5/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice suggests cooperation is key. I think our strategy is robust and should score well."
STRATEGY: Parent: first 3 rounds C, retaliates on last_opp D, chronic-defector rule with opp_defects*3 >= n, my_defects > opp_defects+2 -> C, no last-round defection. Simulated: parent vs revised strategy, slot0, slot1, slot2, slot8, slot10, always-C, always-D, TFT. Changed: added last-round D, forgiveness after provoked defection, chronic-defector detection with opp_defects*2 >= n, and a late-first-defection rule (first_opp_d > 80 -> always D).
